sections.description: Carpet Washing is a purpose-built website theme designed for businesses that offer carpet care, floor maintenance, and home cleaning solutions. This Carpet Washing theme provides a structured layout that helps present services, pricing details, contact information, and business credentials in a clear format. It includes organized sections for service descriptions, testimonials, and appointment details so visitors can easily understand what the business offers. The design focuses on readability, simple navigation, and logical content hierarchy, making it suitable for both small service providers and established cleaning companies. This Carpet Washing services theme supports essential customization options through the Customizer, allowing users to modify colors, typography, logo, and layout settings without editing code. It is built as an SEO-friendly theme with optimized markup and follows modern coding standards. The theme works with the block editor and is Gutenberg compatible, enabling flexible page layouts using native blocks. Additional functional features include translation-ready structure, RTL support, cross-browser compatibility, and a responsive layout that adapts to different screen sizes. These elements help site owners create a business website theme that works reliably across devices and languages. Carpet Washing also includes a customizable homepage layout with sections for service highlights, call-to-action areas, and business information. The minimal design approach keeps visual distractions low while ensuring fast loading performance and accessibility-ready structure. This makes the theme practical for service booking pages, local business sites, and maintenance service providers who need a clean and functional online presence.
